'''Gethnu Cheeve''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] active in the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|Post-Imperial era]]. One [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Gethnu was known to visit was [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]] where the Devaronian would smuggle in illegal goods including poison and dangerous creatures to those who hired them specifically. In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Callista Ming]] was investigating the murder of the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Vrokk]], and searching for the source of the poison used to kill him, she was told by the [[Poet/Legends|poet]] [[Sebastin Onyx]] that Gethnu was one of the people who may of brought the poison onto Gamorr.<ref name="Slushtime" />
